_about: SK hynix fab and packaging sites pinned on the Capex & fabs map (fab_map.py). lon/lat are approximate site-level positions (city or cluster centre, campus offsets for Cheongju); verify before quoting a location. text is what the TUI shows when a site is flown to. src names where each figure came from; KRW figures are as the source states them. dist is the flight camera distance in map units (40 units = 1 degree).

sites.name: Icheon (M10, M14, M16)
sites.text: Headquarters and main DRAM base: M10, M14 and M16 fabs.
sites.src: Korea JoongAng Daily, 'P5, M17, Y2: what Korea's cryptic chip factory names mean' (2026)

sites.name: Cheongju campus (M11, M12, M15)
sites.text: Cheongju campus: M11, M12 and M15 fabs. One report says it makes both DRAM and NAND.

sites.name: M15X (Cheongju)
sites.text: M15X, an extension beside M15. Cleanroom opened Oct 2025. KRW 20T (estimate). Wafer input began 2026Q1. About 50k wafers/month by 2026Q4 (estimate).
sites.src: memory_facts skh-ops: Korea Times 2026-01-13; SK hynix 424B4 prospectus

sites.name: P&T7 (Cheongju, HBM packaging)
sites.text: Advanced packaging for HBM. KRW 19T (company-stated, Jan 2026). Press targets completion in 2027. The 424B4 spend table runs to 2030.

sites.name: M17 (Cheongju, NAND)
sites.text: New NAND fab. Board approved KRW 19.1T (Aug 2026). Press puts the Cheongju NAND plan at KRW 100T, with ops targeted for 1H 2029. The two figures conflict.
sites.src: memory_facts skh-ops: Korea Times 2026-08-07; Herald 2026-07-02 (KRW 100T plan)

sites.name: Yongin Fab 1 (Y1)
sites.text: KRW 31T (company-stated). Construction began Feb 2025. First cleanroom guided for Feb 2027. Sits in Wonsam-myeon, Cheoin-gu, in the Yongin cluster.
sites.src: memory_facts skh-ops: 424B4 prospectus; Korea JoongAng Daily 2026-02-25

sites.name: Yongin Y2
sites.text: KRW 35.2T (company-stated, Aug 2026). First cleanroom guided for Jun 2029. Planned for next-gen DRAM, including HBM (per report). The Yongin cluster total is KRW 600T, done by 2033.

sites.name: Wuxi (China, DRAM)
sites.text: Conventional DRAM fab in Wuxi, Jiangsu. Secondary sources only; check against SK hynix disclosures.

sites.name: Dalian (China, NAND)
sites.text: 300mm NAND fab, run by SK hynix Semiconductor (Dalian), the Chinese subsidiary. Fab 1 about 100k wafers/month. Expansion of about 50k reported.

sites.name: Chongqing (China, NAND back-end)
sites.text: NAND back-end (assembly and test). Secondary sources only; verify.

sites.name: West Lafayette, Indiana (HBM packaging)
sites.text: Advanced HBM packaging at Purdue Research Park. About $3.87B (company-stated). Cleanroom ops 2H 2028. CHIPS Act grant up to $458M.
sites.src: memory_facts skh-ops: NIST CHIPS for America (2024); 424B4 prospectus (2026)
